about.heading: A Tradition of Academic Excellence Since 1972
paragraphs: St. John the Baptist Likuyani Boys High School was established in 1972 through the collaborative efforts of the Catholic Diocese of Eldoret (now Diocese of Kakamega), Chief Likwiro, and Rev. John Njenga.

The school began as a mixed day secondary school and has since evolved into a prestigious boys' boarding institution. In 2010, the school transitioned to an all-boys boarding school, strengthening our focus on developing well-rounded young men.
Located along the Kitale-Eldoret Highway in Likuyani Sub-County, Kakamega County, we continue to provide quality education guided by Catholic values.

admissions.title: Admissions 2026
admissions.subtitle: Begin your journey to excellence. Follow our simple admission process.

steps.heading: Receive Admission Letter
steps.text: Through NEMIS placement or direct application to the school.

steps.heading: Get Endorsement
steps.text: Primary school Head Teacher must endorse your admission letter.

steps.heading: Pay Fees to Bank
steps.text: Deposit Term 1 fees directly to the school bank account. No cash payments accepted.

steps.heading: Report on Opening Day
steps.text: Come with all required documents, bank slip, and personal items on 6th January 2026.
